title: §.XII late (2): Partial assent / Art. X hardness — Tetrapolitani; refused or barred from subscription
pass_a_gloss: Or (2.) they sincerely assent at least to most of the said Confession, although on account of a harder phrasing of one or another Article, especially the tenth, not wholly admitted, they have neither embraced the Confession as a whole nor subscribed to it, either themselves abstaining from Subscription, or prohibited by others: Such as the so-called Tetrapolitans — of Strasbourg, Memmingen, Constance, and Lindau — formerly following Zwingli's dogma on the Lord's Supper, and for that reason exhibiting a peculiar Confession at the Augsburg Diet, yet to be rejected by the Emperor together with the Augsburg. Chytraeus pp. 678, 679. That these refused to subscribe the Augsburg Confession our own writers show passim — Pareus, Georg Pauli, etc. — while others meanwhile, from Chytraeus's History p. 130, maintain that they were coerced from subscribing, at least for several reasons, by the judgment of the Protestant Estates.
pass_b_english: Or (2) they sincerely agree with most of the Confession, yet because of a harder phrasing in one article or another — above all the tenth — they have neither taken the whole Confession nor subscribed, whether by their own abstention or because others barred them.

Such were the so-called Tetrapolitans of Strasbourg, Memmingen, Constance, and Lindau, who once followed Zwingli on the Supper and therefore presented their own Confession at the Augsburg Diet, which the Emperor meant to reject together with the Augsburg.

Chytraeus, pp. 678–679. Our writers (Pareus, Georg Pauli, and others) show that they refused subscription; others, citing Chytraeus's History p. 130, hold that the Protestant Estates' judgment at least partly forced them not to subscribe.
source_text: Vel (2.) plerisque saltem dictae Confessionis, sincero animo adstipulantur, licèt ob duriorem unam vel alteram Articuli, maximè decimi, phrasin haud omnino admissam, nec amplexi Confessionem in totum sint, nec ei subscripserint, à Subscriptione vel semet abstinentes ipsos, vel ab aliis prohibiti: Quales Tetrapolitani vulgò dicti, Argentinenses, Memmingenses, Constantienses & Lindavienses, Zwinglii Dogma de S. Coena olim secuti, exhibitâ ob id peculiari in Comitiis Augustanis, Confessione, una tamen, cum Augustana, à Caesare rejicienda. Chytr. pag. 678. 679. Renuisse hos subscribere Augustanae Confessioni, ostendunt passim Nostrates, Pareus, Georgius Pauli, &c. aliis interim e Chytraeo Historia, pag. 130. sustinentibus, eos à subscribendo, ex Statuum Protestanticorum sententia, per plura saltem, coercitos fuisse.
